conbody.p: The Surround View Monitor’s Rear-view function assists you with safe parking by displaying activity behind the vehicle on the navigation system, according to your selected settings.

section.title: Parking
section.p: The Surround View Monitor’s Rear-view function activates when you are parking under the following conditions:

li.p: You press the Parking/View button (1), then select Rear View with the view switching button (2) while the gear is set to P (Park), N (Neutral), or D (Drive) with a speed below 10 km/h (6 mph).
You shift the gear to R (Reverse).

section.p: Press the view switching button (2) on the Surround View Monitor to select Top View, Front View, Side View, or Wide View.
The Surround View Monitor’s Rear-view function turns OFF when you are parking under the following conditions and the gear is set to P (Park), N (Neutral), or D (Drive):

li.p: You shift the gear from N (Neutral) or D (Drive) to P (Park).
You press the back button (3) on the Surround View Monitor screen.
You press the infotainment system power button (4).

section.p: The Surround View Monitor’s Rear-view function turns OFF when you shift the gear from R (Reverse) to P (Park).

li.p: The Rear View always displays when you shift the gear to R (Reverse).
When you shift the gear to R (Reverse), the video does not turn OFF if you press the infotainment system power button (4).
